import pathlib,hashlib,json
base=pathlib.Path('~/forge-evidence/pi-atdd/plt-85-evaluator-verdicts/batch-1')
rows=[]
for src in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').glob('r-*/tree')):
 id=src.parent.name; d=json.loads((base/id/'hidden-result.json').read_text()); dest=pathlib.Path(d['run']['workDirectory'])/'result'
 files=sorted(p for p in src.rglob('*') if p.is_file()); mismatches=[]; digest=hashlib.sha256()
 for p in files:
  rel=p.relative_to(src); b=p.read_bytes(); digest.update(str(rel).encode()+b'\0'+b)
  if b!=(dest/rel).read_bytes(): mismatches.append(str(rel))
 rows.append({'id':id,'filesCompared':len(files),'sha256':digest.hexdigest(),'contentMismatches':mismatches})
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)); (base/'copy-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
